SELECT X.DenFel, X.IdFel, IIf([idfel]<>0,"REȚETAR","=") AS Expr1 FROM (SELECT DenFel, IdFel FROM Felurimancare GROUP BY DenFel, IdFel UNION ALL SELECT MicDejun.Explicatie, 0 FROM MicDejun WHERE (((MicDejun.Tip) Like [Forms]![ListaAlimente]![mdv])) GROUP BY MicDejun.Explicatie, 0 UNION ALL select tmp_MicDejun.Explicatie, 0 from tmp_MicDejun WHERE tip like [Forms]![ListaAlimente]![mdv])  AS X WHERE (((X.DenFel)<>"")) ORDER BY X.IdFel DESC , X.DenFel;
